title: 第19章 神经内科速救第20章 出手
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 苏业带着些许担忧沉沉睡去。
一夜无梦。
第二天清晨。
金灿的阳光撕碎雾气，震射人间。
苏业睁开眼，望向窗外，空气中还有些潮湿，然而雾气已经消散得七七八八了，那阳光显得格外的金灿，整个城市都仿佛下了一场大雨，干净至极，天空蓝得不像话，连远处那些平时灰扑扑的楼房都被洗出了本来的颜色。
苏业推开窗，深吸一口气。
空气中的灵气浓度比昨天的白雾期间降了不少，但比白雾出现之前要高，这说明昨天那场白雾不是一次性的释放，而是一次永久性的提升，灵气的基础浓度上了一个台阶，只不过普通人觉察不出什么差别罢了。
对普通人来说，今天就是一个普通而且阳光明媚的早晨。
走在去医院的路上，一切恢复了往常的平静。
早餐摊照常营业，公交车照常拥挤，上班族照常行色匆匆，仿佛昨日的白色雾气从未出现过。
这让苏业心中都有些震惊。
他掏出手机刷了一下，网络上有关白色雾气的新闻和帖子已经大面积消失了，昨天那些铺天盖地的短视频、讨论帖、求助帖，要么被删除，要么被限流，搜索关键词几乎什么都搜不到了，只剩下气象局那条“辐射雾与平流雾叠加”的官方声明孤零零地挂在那里。
干净得像是有人拿橡皮擦把昨天从互联网上抹掉了。
苏业收起手机，心中有一种很大的断裂感，昨天还满屏都是恐慌和疑问，今天就什么都没有了，好像所有人都集体失忆了一样。
不过倒也是。
看着路上的行人匆忙赶路，各有各的烦恼，各有各的生计。
生活还得继续啊。
八点整，泌尿外科诊室。
依旧是正常的问诊环节。
苏业配合张远平看了一上午的病人，状态比以前更好了，昨天那次呼吸法修炼带来的提升是全方位的，不只是身体素质，连思维的敏捷度和深度都上了一个台阶。
有几个病例，张远平还在翻检查报告的时候，苏业心里已经有了初步的判断，而且不只是判断，连后续的检查方案和治疗思路都在脑海中排列好了，只等张远平开口问他就能对答如流。
张远平越来越欣赏这个年轻人了，好几次看苏业的眼神里都带着一种“这小子怎么进步这么快”的意味，但他没有多说什么，只是在苏业回答正确的时候多点了几次头。
中午休息的时候，苏业靠在椅子上看手机，嘴角不自觉地带了一丝笑意。
马拉松那个四人小群最近热闹得很。
王丹丹每天都在群里发各种有的没的，今天食堂的红烧肉不错，明天值夜班好困，后天科室来了个奇葩病人，事无巨细都要播报一遍，王罗则是她的忠实捧哏，每条消息都回，还经常发一些莫名其妙的表情包，逗得王丹丹在群里打出一串“哈哈哈哈哈”。
这俩不会要滋生什么‘奸情’吧？
苏蓓偶尔冒出来说一句，温温柔柔的，这也就是她的性格。
苏业自己很少说话，他是高冷淡人，偶尔回个“嗯”或者一个表情，也符合他的强者人设，但这不妨碍其他三个人经常提及他，“苏哥你觉得呢”“苏业你今天吃了吗”“苏哥你是不是又在加班”，搞得苏业每次打开群聊都有一堆@他的消息。
现在的生活还挺有意思的，简单，朴实，同时充满希望。
只是不知道这份安宁何时会被打破。
下午两点，苏业正在录入病历，手机忽然响了。
content_en:
Su ye fell asleep with a little worry.
A dreamless night.
…
Early the next morning.
The golden sunshine shreds the fog and shines into the world.
Su ye opened his eyes and looked out the window. There was still some moisture in the air, but the fog had dissipated to some extent. The sunshine looked particularly golden. The whole city seemed to have been rained heavily. It was extremely clean. The sky was so blue that even the usually gray buildings in the distance were washed out of their original color.
Su ye opened the window and took a deep breath.
The concentration of spiritual energy in the air has dropped a lot compared to yesterday's white fog, but it is higher than before the white fog appeared. This shows that yesterday's white fog was not a one-time release, but a permanent increase. The basic concentration of spiritual energy has reached a higher level, but ordinary people can't notice any difference.
For ordinary people, today is an ordinary and sunny morning.
…
On the way to the hospital, everything returned to its usual calm.
The breakfast stalls are open as usual, the buses are still crowded as usual, and the office workers are in a hurry as usual, as if yesterday's white mist has never appeared.
This shocked Su ye.
He took out his mobile phone and swiped through it. News and posts about white fog had largely disappeared from the Internet. The overwhelming number of short videos, discussion posts, and help posts yesterday had either been deleted or had their traffic restricted. Searching for keywords revealed almost nothing. Only the official statement from the Meteorological Administration on "superposition of radiation fog and advection fog" hung there alone.
It’s as clean as if someone took an eraser and wiped yesterday off the internet.
Su ye put away his phone, feeling a great sense of rupture in his heart. Yesterday, the screen was full of panic and questions, but today there is nothing there, as if everyone has collectively lost their memory.
But that's true.
Watching the pedestrians on the road hurrying along, everyone has their own worries and livelihoods.
Life must go on.
…
Eight o'clock sharp, urology clinic.
It is still a normal consultation session.
Su Ye cooperated with Zhang Yuanping to see the patient all morning, and his condition was better than before. The improvement brought about by the breathing method training yesterday was all-round, not only the physical fitness, but also the agility and depth of thinking were improved to a higher level.
In several cases, while Zhang Yuanping was still looking through the examination reports, Su Ye had already made a preliminary judgment in his mind, and not only the judgment, but also the follow-up examination plan and treatment ideas were arranged in his mind, and he could answer fluently just waiting for Zhang Yuanping to ask him.
Zhang Yuanping admired this young man more and more. He looked at Su ye several times with a hint of "How come this kid has improved so quickly?", but he didn't say anything more. He just nodded a few times when Su ye answered correctly.
During the lunch break, Su ye leaned on his chair and looked at his phone, with a smile unconsciously appearing on his lips.
The four-person marathon group has been very lively recently.
Wang Dandan posts all kinds of things in the group every day. The braised pork in the canteen today is good, she will be sleepy on the night shift tomorrow, and a strange patient comes to the department the day after tomorrow. Every detail must be reported. Wang Luo is her loyal supporter, replying to every message, and often posts some incomprehensible emoticons, making Wang Dandan type a series of "Hahahahaha" in the group.
There won't be any 'adultery' between these two, right?
Su Bei occasionally said something gentle and gentle, which was her character.
Su ye himself rarely speaks. He is aloof. He occasionally replies with "hmm" or an expression, which is in line with his strong persona. However, this does not prevent the other three people from mentioning him frequently, "Brother Su, what do you think?" "Su ye, have you eaten today?" "Brother Su, are you working overtime again?" Every time Su ye opens the group chat, there are a lot of @him messages.
Life now is quite interesting, simple, simple, and full of hope.
I just don't know when this peace will be broken.
…
At two o'clock in the afternoon, Su ye was entering medical records when his cell phone suddenly rang.
